LLC_BI__Narrative__c: FY2025 annual credit review of the Hartwell Industrial Group completed 31 March 2026. Relationship performing as agreed across all six facilities. FY2025 revenue of $85.0MM (+9.4% YoY) on EBITDA of $11.4MM. All four financial covenants compliant at 31 December 2025. Risk grade affirmed at 4. Recommendation: renew the revolving line at existing terms and continue to monitor Fixed Charge Coverage monthly through the Kokomo construction period.
Name: R-5
cm_Recommendation_Narrative__c: Renew the $15.0MM revolving line at SOFR plus 275 bps on existing covenants. Maintain monthly borrowing base reporting. Monitor Fixed Charge Coverage monthly until the Kokomo facility reaches completion and the construction facility converts to permanent.
cm_Relationship_Summary__c: Full banking relationship since 2012 covering six credit facilities, operating deposits and, from 2026, an expanding treasury services mandate. Primary contacts are James Hartwell (CEO) and Elena Hartwell (CFO).
cm_Risk_Rating_Comments__c: Risk grade affirmed at 4. Leverage of 2.42x and DSC of 1.38x remain within policy for the segment. No adverse trend identified.
cm_Strengths_Narrative__c: Long operating history under consistent family ownership; diversified end markets across aerospace, defence, heavy truck and medical devices; AS9100D and ITAR credentials creating switching costs; consistent positive operating cash flow; unlimited corporate and personal guaranties supporting the structure.
cm_Weakness_Narrative__c: Customer concentration with the top five at 41% of sales; Fixed Charge Coverage cushion of 7 bps is the thinnest in the covenant package; construction completion risk on the Kokomo expansion through November 2026; equipment collateral valued on an orderly liquidation basis rather than fair market value.
